title: The Free Lead Scraper Still Costs $130 a Month
description:
There is a real open-source Claude Code skill for cold outbound, and it is genuinely good. But a skill cannot find email addresses on its own, and the repo's own README prices the stack it needs at about $360 for the first month and $130 every month after.

#shorts #claudecode #leadgeneration
transcript: You'll see people say, a free Claude skill replaces Apollo for finding leads. The skill is real. I went and read what it actually costs to run. It's called Cold Outbound Skills, 583 stars, open source, and it genuinely does work. But a skill can't find email addresses. It orchestrates. The actual finding gets done by a paid provider called Prospeo. Their own README prices it out. About $20 per 2,000 leads, plus $5 more just to check the addresses are real. And the minimum setup they recommend needs 4 paid services, roughly $360 the first month, then $130 every month after. So it isn't free, it's unbundled. That can genuinely beat one big subscription, but go in with the real number, follow for more.
